description: This file defines a Java interface named VoicemailFilter, which specifies a method for obtaining a SQL where clause to filter voicemail queries. It is part of a voicemail handling component in an Android application.

classes.name: VoicemailFilter
classes.description: A Java interface for applying filters on voicemail query results, providing a method to retrieve the SQL where clause.

methods.name: getWhereClause
methods.description: Returns the SQL WHERE clause for filtering voicemails or null if the filter is empty.
